provenance: AI-generated photorealistic demonstration; not a photograph of an actual athlete
style: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one high-resolution COLOR photorealistic exercise demonstration for a mobile strength-training app. Landscape 4:3. Exactly ONE athletic adult man with short dark hair, charcoal sleeveless athletic shirt, dark shorts, and white flat training shoes on BOTH feet. Clean uncluttered gym with neutral gray floor and background, soft bright lighting, realistic skin/fabric/metal textures, crisp hands and joints. Frame the entire athlete and functional equipment, subject filling frame with small margins. One pose, one photo, NO collage, NO panels, NO inset, NO labels, NO logos, NO watermark. Anatomically correct limbs, natural joint positions, realistic physical support and load connections. Never depict a recognizable celebrity. Show the exact named exercise and equipment, not a similar exercise.

movements.pose: 30-degree incline dumbbell bench press at controlled bottom position. Adjustable bench at shallow 30-degree incline, head upper back and butt supported, feet planted, one dumbbell at each side of upper chest, elbows near 90 degrees, forearms vertical, wrists aligned, elbows moderately tucked, not flared straight sideways.

30-degree incline Smith machine bench press, controlled bottom position. Athlete supine on shallow inclined bench inside Smith rack; BOTH ends of bar physically attached to vertical guide rails, plates symmetric, safety stops visible. Bar just above upper chest, forearms vertical, thumb-around grip, feet planted, head shoulders butt supported.

Seated converging chest press MACHINE, mid-press. Seated upright against vertical backrest, feet planted, two chest-height handles in hands, elbows moderately tucked, forearms aligned with forward push. Visible connected lever arms pivot from machine frame, weight-stack cable mechanically connected. NOT an overhead press.

Seated pec-deck chest fly MACHINE with handgrips, near closed position. Upright back supported, feet on floor, slightly bent elbows, hands together IN FRONT of sternum at chest height. Two connected machine lever arms curve to handles. Athlete faces away from backrest, NOT reverse fly.

FLAT dumbbell bench press at bottom. Bench perfectly horizontal, supine head shoulders butt supported, both feet floor, two dumbbells beside middle chest, wrists over elbows, elbows bent around 90 degrees and moderately tucked. Entire horizontal bench and feet visible.

Chest-biased parallel-bar dip at controlled lower position. Hands gripping two parallel waist-high bars, feet OFF floor, knees slightly bent, torso tilted slightly forward, elbows bent about 90 degrees, shoulders not forced far below elbows. No extra weight; full bars and hands visible.

HIGH-TO-LOW standing cable chest fly near closed position. Two pulleys visibly ABOVE head height at either side, cables slope down from pulleys to one handle per hand. Split stance, torso stable, elbows slightly bent, hands converge in front of lower chest/upper abdomen. Both pulley origins visible. NOT low-to-high.

FLAT BARBELL bench press at controlled lower position. Horizontal bench in power rack with safety bars just below working bar. Supine, feet planted, head shoulder butt supported, bar just above middle chest, moderate grip, thumb-around hands, forearms vertical. Symmetric weight plates, bar not neck.

FLAT Smith machine bench press. Horizontal bench inside Smith rack, both bar ends connected to vertical rails, safety stops visible. Supine, feet planted, bar above middle chest, elbows bent with vertical forearms and thumbs-around grip. No inclined bench.

LOW-TO-HIGH standing cable fly near closed position. Two pulleys near floor on either side visibly connected by rising cables to handgrips. Split stance, slightly bent elbows, hands converge forward at upper chest height, torso upright stable. Pulley origins near floor visible. NOT high pulleys.

Standing MID-HEIGHT horizontal cable chest fly. Both pulleys at CHEST HEIGHT on either side, cables run approximately horizontally to hands. Split stance stable, elbows softly bent, both handles converge in front of sternum. Not overhead or floor-height cables.

DECLINE dumbbell press at controlled lower position. Actual decline bench with head end LOW and knee/foot restraint HIGH. Athlete supine with legs secured, two dumbbells beside chest, forearms vertical. Head fully supported, full decline bench and restraints visible. NOT incline.

SEATED DIP MACHINE, midway through push downward. Athlete seated upright on seat with backrest, feet planted, gripping paired handles beside hips, elbows bent and moving downward/back. Visible machine connected pivoting dip levers and weight stack. NOT hanging free on parallel bars, NOT chest-level forward press.

Shallow 30-degree INCLINE BARBELL bench press at bottom in power rack. Bench head end higher, head shoulders butt supported, feet floor, free barbell with symmetric plates above upper chest, elbows moderately tucked, vertical forearms, safety bars and rack visible. NOT Smith rails.

Deficit push-up using TWO separate low sturdy push-up handles on floor. Bottom position with chest slightly below hand level, elbows moderately tucked, full body straight from shoulders to heels, toes of SHOES on floor, hands securely grip handles. No bench, not dumbbell row.

FLAT DUMBBELL CHEST FLY at comfortable open position. Supine on horizontal bench, head shoulders butt supported, feet planted, arms open out to sides at chest level, elbows remain only gently bent around 20 degrees, dumbbells held securely, shoulders not excessively dropped. NOT a bench press with deeply bent elbows.

DECLINE free BARBELL bench press in rack at bottom. Decline bench head end lower, knees feet restrained at higher end, head supported, symmetric bar above lower/middle chest, vertical forearms, safety bars. Entire decline angle visible. No dumbbells, no Smith rails.

DUMBBELL FLOOR PRESS. Athlete lies supine directly on gym floor/mat, knees bent and shoes planted, upper arms lightly touch floor with elbows near 90 degrees, two dumbbells above elbows beside chest. NO BENCH of any kind. Clear floor contact under arms and back.

movements.pose: Single-arm CABLE scaption/lateral raise, arm lifted near shoulder height about 30 degrees forward of frontal plane. Athlete standing side-on to one LOW pulley, cable runs from low origin to one handle in raised hand, elbow softly bent, thumb neutral, other hand supports frame. Not front raise, no dumbbell.

Standing DUMBBELL SCAPTION raise, both arms lifted approximately shoulder height in planes 30 degrees forward of straight lateral, elbows softly bent, thumbs neutral/slightly upward, one light dumbbell each hand, body upright. Arms wide diagonally forward, NOT straight forward front raise, no shrug.

REVERSE PEC DECK MACHINE rear-delt fly. Athlete seated FACING padded chest support with chest against it, feet grounded, hands holding two machine handles OUT WIDE at shoulder height, elbows slightly bent. Visible pivoting lever arms. Not regular pec-deck closing hands in front; chest faces pad.

Seated converging SHOULDER PRESS MACHINE at midway up. Athlete back against upright backrest, feet grounded, connected machine lever handles above shoulder height, forearms nearly vertical, palms forward or neutral. Machine arms pivot overhead. Not chest press, no loose dumbbells.

Standing cable FACE PULL with external rotation at completed pull. Rope connected to pulley at eye level in FRONT of athlete. Rope ends pulled apart beside temples, elbows outward near shoulder level, forearms nearly vertical upward, fists beside temples, torso stable. Clear taut cable to face-height pulley. Not triceps pushdown.

SEATED DUMBBELL shoulder overhead press mid-press. Seated on near-upright backrest bench, feet grounded, head neutral, two dumbbells above shoulder level, elbows bent with forearms vertical, no extreme lumbar arch, shirt covering torso. No barbell or machine handles.

Standing CROSS-CABLE rear delt fly at open position. Two cable origins at shoulder height on either side; athlete holds LEFT cable in RIGHT hand and RIGHT cable in LEFT hand so cables visibly CROSS in front. Arms spread wide with slightly bent elbows at shoulder height, torso upright. No pec-deck machine.

BENT-OVER DUMBBELL reverse fly. Standing hip hinge torso nearly horizontal, spine neutral, knees softly bent, two light dumbbells with arms spread sideways, elbows slightly bent. Full feet and hip hinge visible; no bench support and no upright torso.

movements.variant: 侧卧上斜凳单臂侧平举
movements.pose: SIDE-LYING INCLINE single-arm dumbbell lateral raise. Athlete lies on LEFT SIDE supported by bench backrest inclined 45 degrees, feet safely braced, left side contacts padding, right arm lifted away from torso toward lateral shoulder level with a light dumbbell. Lower arm steadies bench. NOT seated bilateral shoulder press.

STANDING free BARBELL overhead press near top. Upright full-body athlete, feet hip-width grounded, bar held overhead slightly in front of crown, arms extended naturally, ribcage not flared, no exaggerated lean. Barbell symmetric plates, thumbs-around grip, no bench and no Smith machine.

SEATED ARNOLD DUMBBELL PRESS at distinctive STARTING position: both dumbbells IN FRONT of shoulders/upper chest, palms facing athlete, elbows bent pointing forward, back supported on near-upright bench, feet grounded. This is initial inward-facing grip before rotation overhead; not ordinary palms-forward shoulder press.

Standing WIDE-GRIP CABLE UPRIGHT ROW. Long straight bar attached at center to LOW pulley in front, hands wider than shoulders, bar lifted near lower sternum, elbows out and approximately shoulder height or slightly below, wrists below elbows, torso upright. Clearly visible cable runs DOWN to floor pulley, not barbell free weight.

SEATED SMITH MACHINE overhead shoulder press. Athlete on upright bench inside Smith rack, feet grounded, bar around just above shoulder/face-front level, forearms upright, both ends attached to vertical rails, safety stops visible. Bar IN FRONT of head, not behind neck, not lying bench press.

SEATED OVERHAND LAT PULLDOWN at lower position. Athlete facing tall overhead cable machine, thighs under firm knee pad, feet grounded, wide overhead bar pulled to upper chest IN FRONT of head, elbows pointing down, torso only slight lean. Taut cable runs from bar center UP to overhead pulley. Not behind-neck.

CHEST-SUPPORTED T-BAR ROW machine. Athlete face down on inclined chest pad, feet on machine platforms, chest continuously resting on pad, hands pulling paired neutral handles toward ribs, visible plate-loaded T-bar lever below connected to pivot. Chest support essential and fully visible; not unsupported barbell row.

SINGLE-ARM standing split-stance LOW CABLE LAT ROW. Cable pulley in front around waist or lower, one handle pulled toward same-side hip with elbow close to torso, torso stable square, other hand supports machine frame. Visible cable connects from front pulley to working hand. Not overhead pulldown and no dumbbell.

WEIGHTED NEUTRAL-GRIP PULL-UP near top. Athlete suspended from TWO parallel overhead handles, palms face each other, chin near handle level, elbows down, body steady. Small weight plate safely suspended between knees by clearly connected DIP BELT CHAIN around waist. Feet off floor, full hanging body visible. Not pronated straight-bar grip.

BENT-OVER free BARBELL ROW at top. Standing feet grounded, knees softly bent, hip hinge with torso about 45 degrees from horizontal, neutral spine, free bar pulled to lower ribs, elbows back, two hands overhand. Symmetric plates, no chest pad or bench, no Smith rails.

SEATED CABLE ROW neutral V-handle at pull position. Athlete seated on low rowing bench, feet braced on footplates, knees slightly bent, torso tall stable, V-handle held at lower ribs, palms face each other. Taut cable runs forward to LOW pulley between footplates. No chest pad, not lat pulldown.

STANDING STRAIGHT-ARM CABLE PULLDOWN near bottom. High overhead pulley in FRONT, long bar connected at center, hands shoulder width gripping bar at front of thighs, elbows almost straight with slight fixed bend, torso slight hip hinge stable. Visible taut cable from overhead pulley to bar. NOT kneeling crunch, NOT elbow-bending triceps pushdown.

WIDE-GRIP CHEST-SUPPORTED ROW MACHINE. Athlete seated with chest pressed against vertical front pad, feet grounded, hands wide on horizontal handles, elbows out about 60 degrees pulling handles toward upper/middle ribs. Visible connected lever arms and chest pad. Not seated cable V-handle or unsupported row.

SMITH MACHINE bent-over row, bar pulled to lower ribs. Feet grounded, knees softly bent, hip hinge torso about 45 degrees, neutral spine, hands overhand, both bar ends connected to vertical guide rails. No chest support, no bench, not deadlift upright.

45-DEGREE ROMAN CHAIR BACK EXTENSION at TOP neutral position. Athlete prone facing down, hips/thighs supported by angled pads, ankles secured, torso aligns straight with legs, arms crossed chest, spine neutral NO hyperextension. Entire 45-degree stand and ankle supports visible.

ONE-ARM DUMBBELL ROW using flat bench. LEFT hand and LEFT knee supported on bench, RIGHT foot planted floor, back neutral nearly horizontal, RIGHT hand holds dumbbell pulled beside right hip/ribs, right elbow back. One dumbbell only. Clear three-point support, not reverse fly.

CONVENTIONAL BARBELL DEADLIFT near floor START. Bar with full-size symmetrical plates rests close to shins on floor, feet hip-width INSIDE hands, both hands grip just outside knees, hips back, knees bent, spine neutral, chest braced. Side three-quarter view includes entire body and plates. NOT sumo wide stance, not straight-leg RDL.

SUPINE CABLE PULLOVER on FLAT bench. Athlete lies lengthwise with head back butt supported and feet floor, upper arms moving from overhead toward vertical, elbows gently bent fixed. Short bar held with two hands connected via taut cable to LOW pulley BEHIND head end of bench. No dumbbell, no crunch, no unsupported cross-bench hips.

SEATED LEG CURL MACHINE, knees flexed around 70-90 degrees. Athlete upright back against seat, thighs secured UNDER top thigh restraint, LOWER moving roller presses behind lower calves above heels, feet curling DOWN and BACK beneath seat. Knee aligned with visible pivot. Full upper thigh pad and rear calf roller clearly distinct. NOT leg extension front shin roller.

45-DEGREE LEG PRESS, controlled bent-knee position. Athlete reclines in fixed seat, back butt supported, both shoes flat on large sled footplate, knees track over feet, knees about 90 degrees. Large plate-loaded sled follows diagonal 45-degree rails UP and AWAY. Safety handles visible. No standing hack squat.

SEATED LEG EXTENSION machine near extended position. Athlete upright back against seat, thighs on seat, knees aligned with pivot, moving roller rests IN FRONT of lower shins above ankles, legs extended forward nearly horizontal. Handles gripped, shoes visible. NOT leg curl roller behind calves.

BARBELL ROMANIAN DEADLIFT at controlled bottom. Standing hip-width feet, knees slightly bent NOT deep squat, hips pushed far back, torso hinged forward with neutral spine, free bar held close against lower legs BELOW knees but ABOVE floor. Arms straight, symmetric plates, side view clearly shows hip hinge. NOT conventional floor start.

DEDICATED HIP THRUST MACHINE at top. Athlete upper back supported on low machine back pad, feet flat on floor/platform, knees around 90 degrees, hips raised until torso and thighs roughly horizontal. Wide padded safety BELT/LAP RESTRAINT across pelvis visibly attached to plate-loaded pivoting lever. Not loose barbell, no weight on abdomen or neck.

STANDING CALF RAISE machine at top. Athlete upright under TWO padded shoulder yokes, hands steady on handles, forefeet on raised step, heels elevated over edge, knees naturally straight not hyperextended, both shoes visible. Connected machine upright frame and weight stack visible. Not seated calf raise.

HIGH-BAR BACK SQUAT at controlled bottom near thighs parallel. Bar rests on muscular UPPER TRAPS below neck, free bar symmetric plates, hands support, feet stable slightly wider hips, knees track toes, spine controlled. Power rack with safety arms visible; no Smith machine. Full side three-quarter body view.

BULGARIAN REAR-FOOT-ELEVATED split squat bottom. Front shoe firmly on floor, back foot shoelaces rest on low flat bench BEHIND, front knee bent, pelvis square, torso slightly leaning stable. One dumbbell each hand hanging at sides. Both front foot and rear bench contact visible. Not ordinary forward lunge.

SEATED HIP ADDUCTOR MACHINE, controlled mid-closing position. Athlete seated back supported, legs moderately apart, paired thigh/knee pads contact INNER sides of thighs, feet on footrests, knees squeeze pads INWARD toward each other. Visible machine handles and connected levers. Pads MUST be INSIDE knees, not outer pads of abductor machine.

PRONE LYING LEG CURL machine at curled position. Athlete lies FACE DOWN lengthwise on padded bench, hips chest supported, hands grip front handles, knees bend lifting shoes toward butt. Padded moving roller across BACK of lower calves above heels, not behind knees. Full lying bench visible, no seated posture.

SEATED CALF RAISE MACHINE at top. Athlete seated upright, knees bent 90 degrees with broad padded lever resting on lower thighs above knees, forefeet on small raised platform, heels lifted, handles held. Plate-loaded connected lever visible. Not standing shoulder pads.

LOW-BAR BACK SQUAT near thighs parallel. Free bar supported across REAR DELTOIDS below upper trapezius, securely held by hands, torso leaned MORE forward than high-bar squat with neutral braced spine, hips back, feet planted, knees track toes. Side-rear three-quarter angle clearly reveals low bar placement, power rack safety arms.

WALKING DUMBBELL LUNGE at low split stance. One dumbbell hangs each side, FRONT foot entirely planted, front knee bent, REAR heel lifted and knee hovering above floor, torso stable. Full side view includes feet and weights. No bench under rear foot, no barbell.

STANDING GLUTE KICKBACK MACHINE. Athlete leans chest/forearms on front machine support, standing foot grounded, working foot presses rear moving footplate BACK behind body with modest hip extension, pelvis square spine neutral. Visible connected pivoting lever and working shoe contact. Not cable ankle cuff, not kneeling bodyweight donkey kick.

KNEELING CABLE CRUNCH. Athlete kneels facing high pulley, rope ends held gently beside temples, elbows remain near head. Torso visibly curls bringing ribcage toward pelvis, hips mostly above knees, rope connected to OVERHEAD pulley. No standing pushdown, no straight-arm lat pulldown. Shoes on kneeling feet.

HANGING KNEE RAISE at top. Athlete grips fixed overhead pull-up bar, arms supporting full body, both knees bent and drawn toward lower chest with modest pelvic curl, feet off floor, no swinging. Entire hands bar knees and shoes visible. Not captain-chair elbow supports.

SEATED ABDOMINAL CRUNCH MACHINE. Athlete seated feet stabilized, upper torso flexed slightly forward against paired padded shoulder levers, hands grip chest/shoulder-height handles, pelvis remains seated. Clearly visible dedicated seated ab machine linked moving torso resistance, not cable rope and not leg curl.

KNEELING AB WHEEL ROLLOUT halfway extended. Knees on mat, both hands grip two handles of SINGLE wheel axle, wheel rolled forward on floor, arms extended forward, torso pelvis controlled in straight line from shoulders toward knees, no sagging lower back. Feet in SHOES behind, side view, not standing extreme rollout.

DECLINE WEIGHTED CRUNCH near top small curl. Athlete supine on decline bench with head lower and feet securely restrained higher, knees bent, single small weight plate held firmly AGAINST chest, shoulders curl off padding without full sit-up, pelvis supported. No weight behind head.

STANDING HIGH-TO-LOW CABLE WOODCHOP. Sideways to high pulley, both hands hold SINGLE handle moved diagonally down across torso toward opposite hip. Feet spaced planted with modest coordinated hip/foot pivot, arms extended but softly bent, visible taut cable slopes from HIGH origin. Not horizontal Pallof anti-rotation.

STANDING PALLOF ANTI-ROTATION PRESS. Athlete side-on to pulley at chest height, BOTH hands hold ONE handle pushed straight FORWARD away from sternum, elbows nearly straight. Torso square looking ahead, hips no rotation, stance shoulder width. Taut cable visibly pulls FROM SIDE horizontally, not diagonal woodchop or overhead press.

SIDE BEND on 45-degree Roman chair. Athlete rests RIGHT side of hip on padded support with feet secured sideways at lower end, torso slightly laterally bent sideways over pad with shoulders not rotated, arms crossed chest. Side-lying angle clear, full apparatus visible. NOT prone back extension and NOT leg lift.

WEIGHTED FOREARM PLANK using a securely worn compact WEIGHTED VEST. Elbows on mat directly below shoulders, forearms forward, toes in shoes floor, body straight head to heels, pelvis level. No loose plate precariously placed on lower back. Full side view shows vest and correct plank.

SEATED WEIGHTED RUSSIAN TWIST. Athlete sitting on mat, knees bent with BOTH SHOES planted on floor, torso leaning modestly back with controlled spine, light medicine ball held by both hands close to torso rotated slightly to one side. No feet lifted, no supine bicycle crunch, no extreme twisting.

STANDING OVERHEAD CABLE TRICEPS EXTENSION. Athlete faces AWAY from low-to-mid pulley behind, split stance, hands holding rope BEHIND/above head with elbows bent and upper arms angled overhead forward. Visible cable rises from rear pulley to rope, torso stable no exaggerated arch. Not face pull or pushdown.

STANDING ROPE TRICEPS PUSHDOWN near bottom. Pulley HIGH directly in front, rope connected above, upper arms remain beside torso, elbows nearly extended, rope ends in hands just beside front thighs, palms face each other, torso upright. Visible cable from high pulley. Not straight-arm lat pull with shoulder sweep.

UPRIGHT TRICEPS parallel-bar DIP at controlled halfway down. Athlete suspended on two parallel bars, torso relatively vertical unlike forward chest dip, elbows bent and directed back, knees mildly bent feet off floor, shoulders controlled not deeply sunk. Full hand contacts and bars visible.

LYING EZ-BAR TRICEPS EXTENSION / skull crusher. Supine on flat bench, head shoulders butt supported, feet planted; upper arms angled slightly back from vertical, elbows flexed, EZ bar controlled slightly BEHIND forehead not touching face, palms around curved grips. Symmetric light plates. Not bench press with elbows out.

SINGLE-ARM REVERSE-GRIP CABLE TRICEPS PUSHDOWN. High pulley in front with single D-handle, working hand holds SUPINATED palm-up grip, upper arm at torso, elbow near extended with handle beside front thigh, other hand steady frame. Wrist neutral, cable taut to high origin. Not curl from low pulley.

SINGLE-ARM DUMBBELL TRICEPS KICKBACK. Left hand and left knee supported on flat bench, right foot floor, torso hinged neutral nearly horizontal, RIGHT upper arm held beside torso, right elbow extends hand/dumbbell BACK behind hip. Clear upper arm stable and elbow extended, not bent-elbow dumbbell row.

SEATED INCLINE DUMBBELL BICEPS CURL on 50-degree backrest. Athlete reclined back supported feet floor, arms hang slightly behind torso, elbows flexed halfway, one dumbbell each hand palms face upward/forward, shoulders stay down. No overhead press, no standing torso swing.

EZ-BAR PREACHER CURL at mid-curl. Athlete seated behind angled preacher pad, BOTH upper arms resting flush on pad with armpits near upper edge, hands grip curved EZ-bar with light symmetric plates, elbows flexed. Torso stable, feet floor, wrist neutral. Not spider curl chest on bench.

STANDING DUMBBELL HAMMER CURL at mid-curl. Upright athlete, one dumbbell each hand, both palms facing inward toward each other and THUMBS UP, elbows beside torso flexed near 90 degrees. No supination, no cables, no shoulder swing, shoes planted.

STANDING EZ-BAR BICEPS CURL at halfway up. Athlete upright feet grounded, hands symmetrically on curved comfortable grip sections of EZ bar, palms up oblique, elbows at torso, bar in front of waist/chest, symmetric light plates. Curved bar obvious, not straight bar, no preacher pad.

DUMBBELL SPIDER CURL. Athlete lies FACE DOWN with CHEST against 45-degree inclined bench backrest, feet braced floor, both upper arms hang down freely beyond sides of pad, elbows flex to lift two dumbbells. Chest pad contact unmistakable. No preacher arm pad, no standing arm-blaster.

SEATED DUMBBELL WRIST FLEXION CURL. Athlete seated feet grounded, BOTH FOREARMS fully supported on thighs palms UP, wrists and hands just beyond knees, each hand securely holds light dumbbell, small wrist flexion curls hands upward while forearms still. Close enough wrists visible but whole seated athlete included. Not elbow biceps curl.

SEATED ONE-ARM DUMBBELL CONCENTRATION CURL. Athlete seated on flat bench legs apart, working upper arm rests against INSIDE same-side thigh just above knee, elbow flexes lifting dumbbell, palm upward, other hand rests opposite thigh. Back stable leaning slightly forward. Not standing curl or preacher pad.

UNDERHAND CHIN-UP near top. Athlete suspended on straight overhead bar, hands approximately shoulder-width, palms facing athlete in SUPINATED grip, elbows down, chin near bar, legs steady feet off floor. Entire hands and grip visible. Not neutral parallel handles, not pronated wide pull-up.

Seated INCLINE CHEST PRESS MACHINE mid press. Inclined backrest about 30 degrees from horizontal, NOT upright shoulder press. Head shoulders butt supported, both feet floor. Two independent lever handles just above upper chest, elbows moderately tucked and flexed, forearms aligned with upward-forward press path. Show the weight-loaded connected machine levers, pivot, frame and seat. Clear side three-quarter view showing incline and chest hand position. No free dumbbells or floating handles.

SINGLE-ARM FLAT DUMBBELL BENCH PRESS at mid press. Athlete supine on horizontal bench, head shoulders butt supported, both white shoes planted widely on floor. Exactly ONE dumbbell in right hand over right chest with bent elbow and vertical forearm, opposite hand rests safely on left hip, no second weight. Hips and trunk level without rotation. Three-quarter side view showing single-arm load and entire bench.

SEATED LATERAL RAISE MACHINE near middle elevation. Upright seated athlete, back supported, feet floor. BOTH upper arms against OUTSIDE lever pads just above elbows, arms lifted diagonally out to sides below shoulder level, elbows naturally bent; hands on machine handgrips. Clearly connected lateral-raise levers pivot near shoulder height and resistance stack. Not shoulder press, not pec fly, no hand-held weights. Front three-quarter view.

STANDING SINGLE-ARM CABLE EXTERNAL SHOULDER ROTATION. Athlete upright, right elbow bent 90 degrees snug beside right ribs with small towel. Pulley at elbow height on athlete LEFT side across torso; right hand holds D handle and rotates OUTWARD rightward, forearm horizontal pointing diagonally outward at 30 degrees from forward. Upper arm stays vertical by ribs. Cable visibly travels from right hand across front of torso to left pulley. Other arm relaxed, torso not twisted. One cable handle only. Front view wide enough show pulley, elbow and hand.

STANDING SINGLE-ARM CABLE INTERNAL SHOULDER ROTATION. Athlete upright, right elbow bent 90 degrees snug beside right ribs with small towel. Pulley at elbow height on athlete RIGHT side. Right hand holds D handle and moves inward across front of abdomen, right forearm horizontal, hand approaching navel. Cable visibly travels from right hand to pulley on right. Upper arm vertical beside ribs, shoulders level, torso not twisted. Other arm relaxed. One cable handle only. Front view showing cable direction and tucked elbow.

SCAPULAR PUSH-UP near protracted top. Athlete high plank on gym mat, both elbows STRAIGHT, palms shoulder-width, toes in white training shoes on floor, head hips heels aligned. Upper back slightly rounded through controlled shoulder-blade protraction, chest gently pushed away from floor WITHOUT bending elbows. No dumbbells, no bent-arm pushup, no pike hips, no sagging lumbar spine. Side three-quarter view entire body palms and shoes.

movements.pose: CHEST-SUPPORTED INCLINE DUMBBELL ROW near contracted top. Athlete face DOWN, chest resting on 35-degree incline bench pad, feet planted on floor outside bench. Exactly two dumbbells in hands pulled beside lower ribs, elbows travel backward close to torso, wrists neutral. Head neutral aligned with back, chest stays against pad, shoulders not shrugged. No preacher arm pad, no upright seated row. Side three-quarter view showing chest contact and both weights.

movements.variant: 坐姿胸支撑器械划船（中立握）
movements.pose: SEATED CHEST-SUPPORTED ROW MACHINE with NEUTRAL grip, mid pull. Athlete facing machine chest pad, sternum supported on pad in FRONT of torso, not backrest. Feet braced, upright neutral torso. Both palms facing inward on parallel vertical handles, elbows pulled beside lower ribs, shoulders level. Connected lever arms visible leading forward to frame and weight stack. Not wide-grip high row, not cable unsupported seated row. Three-quarter side view of chest pad and connected handles.

STANDING DUMBBELL SHRUG at gently elevated top. Athlete upright feet hip-width planted, one dumbbell hanging in each hand beside thighs, palms toward torso, both elbows fully straight. Shoulders lifted vertically toward ears slightly, chin neutral, no shoulder rolling, no elbows curling, no barbell. Front three-quarter view full body showing straight arms and dumbbells beside thighs.

ASSISTED PULL-UP MACHINE mid pull. Athlete hands pronated shoulder-width on overhead pull-up handles, elbows bending down, torso vertical, BOTH KNEES firmly supported on one horizontal counterweighted knee-assist platform connected to vertical machine carriage and weight stack. Lower legs naturally bent behind, both white shoes visible off ground. Show complete overhead grips, frame, knee pad, supporting carriage. Not dips, not feet on loose box, no elastic band. Front three-quarter full body view.

45-degree HACK SQUAT MACHINE controlled mid-depth. Athlete standing against inclined sled back pad with shoulders under two shoulder cushions. BOTH feet flat on fixed large footplate below, knees bent tracking toes, hips and entire back remain supported by moving sled. Sled travels on two 45-degree guide rails behind athlete, symmetric modest plates and safety handles visible. Not seated leg press. Full athlete and rails visible side three-quarter view.

DUMBBELL GOBLET SQUAT at controlled parallel depth. Athlete feet about shoulder-width white shoes flat on ground, knees track toes. Exactly ONE dumbbell held vertically with BOTH palms cupping top end at chest, elbows point downward between knees. Neutral torso moderately inclined, heels grounded, no kettlebell, no dumbbells by sides, no barbell. Three-quarter front view full body.

SMITH MACHINE SQUAT at controlled mid-depth. Athlete bar rests on muscular upper back not neck, hands thumb-around secure grip outside shoulders. Both ends of horizontal bar visibly attached to Smith machine VERTICAL guide rails, modest symmetric plates, safety stops below bar. Feet shoulder-width planted slightly forward, knees track toes, hips lowered with neutral spine. No free rack bar, no front squat. Three-quarter side view full athlete and guide rails.

movements.variant: 史密斯分腿蹲（后脚落地）
movements.pose: SMITH MACHINE SPLIT SQUAT at mid-depth with REAR FOOT ON FLOOR. Athlete facing forward, Smith bar resting upper back secured to two vertical guide rails, light symmetric plates and safety stops. Front foot flat on floor, back foot also ON FLOOR with heel raised and toes grounded. Both knees bent, rear knee hovering above floor, torso upright, front knee aligned toes. NO elevated rear-foot bench, no step, no lunge walking. Side three-quarter showing both foot contacts.

DUMBBELL REVERSE LUNGE controlled bottom after step BACK. Athlete one foot back with toes on floor and heel lifted, front foot flat planted, both knees flexed about 90 degrees, rear knee above ground, trunk neutral upright. One dumbbell in each straight hanging hand beside hips. Show full body and wide enough floor around feet, side three-quarter view. No bench or forward walking lunge, no weight overhead.

SEATED HIP ABDUCTION MACHINE at moderately opened position. Athlete seated upright with back supported, knees bent 90 degrees, BOTH OUTER SIDES of knees/thighs press against padded lever arms. Legs separated outward, feet on connected foot supports, hands on stable side handgrips. Machine pivot and resistance frame visible. Pads must be OUTSIDE knees resisting outward movement, NOT between inner knees as adduction. Front three-quarter angle full seated athlete and machine.

movements.variant: 单腿哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉
movements.pose: SINGLE-LEG DUMBBELL ROMANIAN DEADLIFT at controlled hip hinge. Athlete standing on right leg, right knee softly bent, left leg extended backward in line with torso. Right hip pushes backward, torso tilted forward approximately 45 degrees, neutral spine, pelvis square facing floor.
